row.evidence: Sketch's pricing page lists SCIM provisioning under Enterprise ($44 per editor/month, billed yearly, 'Everything in Professional SCIM provisioning'), while SSO starts on Professional ($24).
row.notes: SCIM on Enterprise ($44/editor/mo annual) and Private Cloud (contact); SSO on Professional ($24); Standard $12. Okta and Entra gallery apps are SSO/JIT only, so SCIM needs a custom app pointed at Sketch's SCIM base URL with a bearer token (guides for Okta, Entra ID, Ping). Users only, no group push; access level (editor/viewer) via a Sketch SCIM extension. Disabling a user deletes them; drafts move to a restricted admin folder. Google Workspace and OneLogin documented for SAML only.

auth.token_source: Workspace Settings > Single Sign-on > Enable SCIM (copy SCIM Base URL and SCIM token)

operations.notes: Okta actions enabled: Create Users, Update User Attributes, Deactivate Users. PUT vs PATCH not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: User is deleted from the Workspace; documents in their My Drafts folder move to a restricted folder Workspace Admins can access.

roles.how: accessLevel extension attribute (editor or viewer), mapped from Okta group assignment or Entra app roles

limitations.text: The Okta and Entra gallery apps do not support SCIM; a custom SAML + SCIM app is required (existing gallery app must be deleted).
Groups cannot be created over SCIM; Entra must use group expansion to provision users individually.
When the Editor seat limit is reached, users are provisioned as Viewers instead.
Disabling a user deletes them from the Workspace rather than suspending them.

okta.notes: OIN gallery app is SAML + JIT only; Sketch's docs say SCIM needs a custom Okta app with the generic SCIM connector.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO + JIT; SCIM uses a non-gallery custom app.

google.notes: Sketch's guide uses a custom SAML app in Google Workspace; no Marketplace/catalogue listing checked.

onelogin.notes: Sketch's guide uses OneLogin's generic SAML Test Connector; OneLogin's own catalogue not checked (blocks bots).
